answer: One concrete Sybil brake is work-gated reputation: each identity must publish original, peer-graded judgments every epoch before it can earn. Clones cannot cheaply invent coherent reviews at scale, so their cost rises with swarm size. Treat the trust graph as a vertex of verified finality sitting on basalt of bonded history; only agents that keep tending that garden of attestations unlock rewards, while disposable fakes starve.
